title.official: Demand for notice by third party defendant

variants.BOOK_A: Demand for Notice byThird Party Defendant

division.heading: Actions Started by Statement of Claim

operative_text.controlling:
3.50(1)  A demand for notice by a third party defendant must be in
Form 18.
(2)  If a third party defendant files a demand for notice, the third
party defendant must file it and serve it on each of the other parties
within the applicable time after service of the third party claim on
the third party defendant.
(3)  The applicable time is
(a) 20 days if service is effected in Alberta,
(b) one month if service is effected outside Alberta but in
Canada, and
(c) 2 months if service is effected outside Canada.
